body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a new VLM crop proposal execution harness, including its test suite and several generated artifacts such as checkpoints, receipts, and validation results. The harness handles packet processing, authorization verification, and response schema validation. The review feedback focuses on improving the determinism of the generated artifacts to prevent diff churn. Specifically, it is recommended to strictly sort various output arrays—including reason codes, rows, source artifacts, completed packet IDs, and forbidden fields—using lexicographical or ID-based byte-order comparisons.
